<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-size:14pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Exhibit 99.1</p>
<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-size:18pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Media release</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#646464;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><img src="g201806121831466174899.jpg" title="" alt="" style="width:138px;height:50px;"></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold;font-size:13pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Jakob Stausholm to succeed Chris Lynch as Rio Tinto&#8217;s chief financial officer</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">12 June 2018</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto has appointed Jakob Stausholm to succeed Chris Lynch as chief financial officer. Mr&#160;Stausholm, who recently stepped down as Group Chief Financial Officer of A.P. Moller &#8211; Maersk, will join Rio Tinto as an executive director on 3 September 2018 and take over as chief financial officer on the same day. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Chris Lynch will stand down from the Rio Tinto board on 3 September 2018 and, as previously announced, will retire from Rio Tinto on 30 September 2018, following a smooth transition to Jakob.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mr Stausholm has over 20 years&#8217; experience working in senior finance roles in Europe, Latin America and Asia. He was Group CFO and an executive director of A.P. Moeller &#8211; Maersk A/S and Chief Financial, Strategy &amp; Transformation Officer for the Transport &amp; Logistics division from December 2016 until March 2018, having joined the Maersk Group in 2012. From 2008 to 2011 he was Group CFO of the global facility services provider ISS A/S and he was a non-executive director of Statoil ASA from 2009 to 2016 and of Woodside Petroleum from 2006 to 2008. Before that, he spent over 19 years with Royal Dutch Shell in numerous finance positions globally and as Chief Internal Auditor for the group.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto chief executive J-S Jacques said &#8220;I am delighted Jakob is joining Rio Tinto and I look forward to working closely with him as we continue to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. The experience he has gained in various senior financial and strategy roles globally will be invaluable, as will his deep knowledge of both the resources and logistics industries. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;I would also like to acknowledge Chris&#8217;s outstanding contribution to Rio Tinto. He leaves Rio Tinto a stronger company than when he started in 2013. Rio Tinto has the strongest balance sheet in the sector, and Chris has helped embed a disciplined focus on costs and capital allocation. On a personal level, I will greatly miss his wise counsel, good humour and support, and I wish Chris and his family the best of luck for the future.&#8221; </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mr Stausholm said &#8220;I am truly excited to be joining Rio Tinto and look forward to working with J-S and the executive team to ensure Rio Tinto continues to outperform its peers and maintain the financial discipline instilled under J-S and Chris&#8217;s leadership.&#8221;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto chairman Simon Thompson said &#8220;I look forward to welcoming Jakob to the Rio Tinto board. He brings a wealth of experience, both as an executive and non-executive director, that will enrich the Rio Tinto board discussions and ensure continued leadership on disciplined capital allocation and the pursuit of superior shareholder value.  I would also like to thank Chris for his great contribution to the board and to Rio Tinto during his time as chief financial officer.&#8221;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Chris Lynch joined the Rio Tinto board in September 2011 and was appointed chief financial officer in April 2013.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto confirms that, other than as set out above, there are no matters to be disclosed pursuant to Rule 9.6.13 (1) &#8211; (6) of the Listing Rules of the UK Financial Conduct Authority in connection with this appointment.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">LEI: 213800YOEO5OQ72G2R82</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Classification: 3.1 Additional regulated information required to be disclosed under the laws of a Member State.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-align:right;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;color:#646464;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Page 1 of 3</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-right:0.4%;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Notes to editors</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Jakob Stausholm</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Jakob Stausholm will be on a standard Rio Tinto executive contract, which includes a 12-month notice period. He will receive a remuneration package that is in line with our remuneration policy and benchmarked against FTSE30 and other international mining companies. His remuneration package comprises:</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

For 2018, consistent with the rules of the Plan and the Remuneration Policy, a Performance Share Award (PSA) will be granted in September 2018 of 29,886 Rio Tinto plc shares.&#160; This has been calculated and pro-rated based on the commencement date of 3 September 2018. The award will vest, subject to the achievement of performance conditions, in 2023.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Chris Lynch</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Leaving arrangements for Chris Lynch are governed by the remuneration policy and will be finalised at the date of his retirement.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Chris Lynch will remain as chief financial officer and a member of the Rio Tinto board until 3 September 2018. He will continue to be paid in accordance with his existing contractual remuneration arrangements until his retirement date.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto&#8217;s remuneration policy is published in the Annual report at <font style="text-decoration:underline;">www.riotinto.com</font>. The 2018 Remuneration Implementation report will contain details of remuneration payments described above.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-align:right;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;color:#646464;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Page 2 of 3</p>

<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-size:14pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Exhibit 99.2</p>
<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-size:18pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Media release</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#646464;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><img src="g201806121831348184422.jpg" title="" alt="" style="width:138px;height:50px;"></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-weight:bold;font-size:13pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto proposes to appoint KPMG as external auditor from 2020</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">12 June 2018</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rio Tinto has completed a competitive tender process for the appointment of a new external auditor. Subject to shareholder approval, KPMG will be appointed from the financial year beginning 1 January 2020.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Shareholder approval to confirm the appointment of KPMG will be sought at Rio Tinto&#8217;s annual general meetings in 2020. PwC remains Rio Tinto&#8217;s external auditor, and will undertake the audit of Rio Tinto for the 2019 financial year, subject to reappointment by shareholders at the 2019 annual general meetings.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Ann Godbehere, Chairman of the Audit Committee, said: &#8220;On behalf of the Rio Tinto board, I&#8217;d like to thank PwC for their diligence and dedication over the years. We now look forward to working with KPMG.&#8221;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-align:right;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;color:#646464;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Page 1 of 2</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Contacts</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="line-height:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#313131;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:none;">media.enquiries@riotinto.com</font> </p>
